use-cases.heading: Help everyone make decisions with data
use-cases.summary: Get your data in front of your team. Connect to your data stack in 5 minutes to make queries, visualizations, and dashboards easy for everyone—no SQL required.

sections.heading: Make data easy
sections.summary: Connect to your data stack and showcase your data in a simple, familiar interface. Spreadsheet-like controls make common actions like sorting, filtering, and summarizing feel intuitive and straightforward.

testimonial.summary: "Thanks to Metabase our team members have all sorts of info, and don’t need to bother anyone to get their answers."
testimonial.author: Crystal Widjaja

sections.heading: Unlock the power of queries for all
sections.summary: Help your team dive deeper with an easy-to-learn Visual Query Builder. Working on something complex? No problem—there’s a full SQL Editor for advanced users.

testimonial.summary: "I think the most important moment for me is when I realized how much less time I would spend writing custom queries."
testimonial.author: George Visniuc

sections.heading: Share your insights
sections.summary: Easy-to-build Interactive Dashboards make collecting and sharing your insights a breeze. Share your work with a quick link, or embed directly in your websites, publications, and products.

testimonial.summary: "Now everybody talks more about facts and less about intuition, gut, prior experience, or perceived trends."
testimonial.author: Shanker Sneh

first.summary: "We installed Metabase in 5 minutes, and were able to use it immediately within the company."

second.summary: "We were surprised how many employees started asking their own questions about their data immediately after they picked up Metabase. 70 percent of the company uses Metabase on a regular basis."

use-cases.heading: Share insights with anyone, anywhere
use-cases.summary: Publish live data and visualizations in easy-to-explore interactive dashboards. Share with a quick link, or embed in websites, publications, and products.

sections.heading: Build and publish in minutes
sections.summary: Get everyone on the same page with always-up-to-date Dashboards. Build and publish interactive, explorable data experiences in a few clicks with an easy-to-use drag-and-drop editor.

testimonial.summary: "Before, AngelList didn’t have a standard way to create or share charts easily. Now, with Metabase, we communicate data clearly across the company in an organized fashion."
testimonial.author: Brandon Krull

sections.heading: Inspire exploration with interactivity
sections.summary: Built-in tools like Filters and the Action Menu encourage everyone to use your Dashboards as a jumping-off point for further exploration. Custom links and cross-filtering let you layer in advanced interactivity, connecting multiple Dashboards to build immersive data experiences.

sections.heading: Set up regular Subscriptions or Alerts
sections.summary: Team need regular updates? Use a Subscription to get your dashboard right in your slack channel or inbox. Or set a trigger for a timely Alert—like when a big sale comes in.

testimonial.summary: "We built out queries for Product usage metrics, then dashboards, then alerts. We then scaled it across teams and product lines."
testimonial.author: Will Sanderson

first.summary: "Metabase is helping us to shape a data-driven culture, giving our users the power to build their own questions and making data-driven decisions part of our daily routine!"

second.summary: "More and more, people are beginning to use Metabase themselves, as the interface is flexible and user-friendly allowing non-technical people to create their own dashboards and questions"

use-cases.summary: Quickly and easily embed interactive analytics in your products, with simple but powerful tools to let you match the look and feel of your brand.

sections.heading: Develop, deliver, and iterate fast
sections.summary: Building your embedded reports in Metabase means quick development and iteration cycles, letting you deliver data to your customers even faster.

testimonial.summary: "Metabase lets us launch features in record time! As fast as we can get credentials to the database, because debugging and tracking can be done in literally less than 5 minutes"
testimonial.author: Crystal Widjaja

sections.heading: Interactive reports make exploration a breeze
sections.summary: Allow customers to drill in on charts to explore more on their own, within the data boundaries you define. Customize the interactivity of your dashboards with cross-filtering, custom links, or the powerful built-in Action Menu.

sections.heading: Build it once, customize it for everyone.
sections.summary: Data Sandboxes help you make sure that your customers only ever see their data. Integrate Metabase with your app’s auth to automatically give customers the right permissions.

first.summary: "We now have interactive dashboards that we present to our clients and offer them access to useful key metrics. So far we’ve received overwhelmingly positive feedback."

second.summary: "Embedding Metabase has allowed us to quickly develop, iterate and maintain analytics on our platform that would've taken a lot engineering efforts otherwise. We love Metabase."
